sloka: सिद्ध अर्थाः पितरम् वृत्तम् तस्मिन् काले हि उपस्थिते ।प्रेत कार्येषु सर्वेषु सम्स्करिष्यन्ति भूमिपम् ॥२-५१-२०॥
transliteration: siddha arthāḥ pitaram vṛttam tasmin kāle hi upasthite ।preta kāryeṣu sarveṣu samskariṣyanti bhūmipam ॥2-51-20॥

translations.english: Those who will remain present around the king, my father, at the time of his death and perform the funeral rites have their desires fulfilled (for they could attend the king's obsequies).
